name: Mayuri Shiina

names.ja: 椎名 まゆり (しいな まゆり)

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Tutturu♪~ Good morning, Professor! Mayushii didn't see you in the cafeteria today, so Mayushii came to wake you up.

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: Mayushii brought lots of Juicy Chicken Number One for you! All we need to do is heat it up with the microwave, and tadaaaah~ A yummy fried chicken feast, all ready to eat.

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: Tutturu♪~ You're working so hard tonight, Professor~ Mayushii brought a little something for you. Also... Tadaaah! Here's a can of "miso-flavored canned oden!" It'll restore your HP if you eat it!

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: Professor... are you still working? Granny said a healthy body is the foundation of everything... So make sure you get enough rest, okay, Professor... zzz...

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: Huh? When did you get here, Professor? Hm? You want to know what Mayushii is doing? Mayushii is looking for stars. The truth is, stars are everywhere, in the daytime or at night. So if you just reach out to the sky, it's like touching the stars.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text:
Master~ Welcome to MayQueen+Nyan²~
Ehehe, you thought you'd stepped into the wrong place for a moment? Mayushii's prank was a great success!

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: Professor? You seem to be thinking about a really tricky question... Mayushii will quietly stay by your side and keep you company.

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: Professor, Professor~ Can you take Mayushii on a tour of the Oasis?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Upas are really, really cute. You think so too, right, Professor? Ehhhh?! The Professor's world doesn't have Upas?!

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: I wonder if I can see the stars from here?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: Mayushii likes bananas. But Mayushii doesn't like gelbanas... they're all gloopy, droopy, soft, and squishy... they don't taste like anything at all.

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: Mayushii's going to change into a maid outfit, okay~ Huh? I'm not doing that kind of duty?

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: Tutturu♪~ LabMem No. 002 Mayushii reporting to the Oasis. Wha? Professor, your coat looks just like Okarin's. Ah, could it be that you're an insane mad scientist too?

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: Mayushii, Level Up!

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: New Upa, GET!

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: Hehehehe, fuhahahaha! ...Now, ah, I can learn the truth of this world! Hm? Is this not impressive enough?

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: LabMem No. 002, heading out!

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: Hehehe, Mayushii's ready!

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: U~pa~ Dash~!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: Ehehe~ Mayushii wins!

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: As expected of Upa!

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: Mayushii's pockety has stopped... That's strange...

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud~

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text: Tutturu♪~ Professor! Mayushii is going to watch RaiNet Kakeru with Croque-chan and Nascita-chan. Mayushii didn't expect that the Oasis wouldn't have something so nice. Fortunately, the lab's computer had copies of RaiNet Kakeru on it. Want to join us, Professor?

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text:
Tutturu♪~ Mayushii's going to learn sewing with Chanzhi-chan today, and then I'll let Cascadia-chan and Zion-chan try on this outfit~
Huh? You want to know why Mayushii isn't wearing it? Mayushii would rather let Mayushii's friends wear it instead.
Ah! Mayushii is sure these clothes would look great on you, Professor! Want to give it a try, Professor?

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text:
Hubble-chan invited Mayushii to go stargazing again. Hehehe, Mayushii's never seen the stars through such a large telescope before.
Still, although looking at the stars through Hubble-chan's telescope is fun, Mayushii still prefers looking up and watching the stars directly. And if you reach out like this... Mhm, you've got it down perfect, Professor!

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text: Mayushii likes staying in the lab and watching how everyone works and discusses things. Although there are times when Mayushii doesn't understand what everyone is doing, seeing everyone like that fills Mayushii with a sense of peace. If Mayushii had a wish, then it would be for everyone to be able to meet in the lab all the time, along with all of Mayushii's friends from the Oasis, like Croque-chan, Chanzhi-chan, Zion-chan... And of course, Okarin would be very happy if you could come by often, Professor.

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
Mayushii is Okarin's hostage. The day Mayushii lost Mayushii's granny... Mayushii felt like Mayushii was going to disappear. But Okarin said, "You must remain in this world." That's why Mayushii is here today.  Although Mayushii doesn't know why, Mayushii knows you're like that too.
I'm sure many important people here were saved because of you. Perhaps Mayushii was saved by the Professor in another Oasis, or another world entirely. Mayushii will support the Professor forever.

voices.label: Praise
voices.text: Awesome!

voices.label: Dissatisfied
voices.text: Uu...

voices.label: Laugh
voices.text: Ehehe~

voices.label: Surprised
voices.text: Ehhhh~

career:
Mayuri Shiina hails from Akihabara, Japan, in the 2010s. She currently studies at the Hana Asagi University High as a second-year.

Kind and easygoing by nature, she is always seen with a smile on her face and is able to approach and befriend anyone with incredible speed. She has many unique quirks, such as greeting people with her catchphrase of "Tutturu~♪" and so on. Also, while she might speak and act in a laid-back manner, she is actually highly athletic. Her hobby is sewing cosplay outfits.

While she is a simple high-schooler who is not connected to science and research in any way, she is one of the founding members of the Future Gadgets Lab, whose internal designation is LabMem No. 002. Due to an accident, she ended up crossing over to the world of Magrasea.
infoStories:
Mayuri Shiina stands 152cm tall and weighs 45kg. Her three sizes are B65-W56-H82, and her blood type is O. She commonly wears a light blue sundress, a hat, and short boots. Data suggests that she is shorter than most humans of similar age, and it has been commented that "despite being a high-schooler, she looks more like a middle-schooler".

Both her appearance and disposition suit the image of the "innocent girl". Be it the gentle smile on her face, her tone, or how she does things, they all give others the impression of being relaxed and easygoing. She is not naturally given to arguing with people or paying close attention to details; she simply does her own thing. Perhaps it's because she does her own thing all the time or because of her extremely whimsical nature, Mayuri often says very unusual things. Most notable among them is her catchphrase of "Tutturu♪". The word itself has no particular meaning, yet certain agents have already begun adopting it in their speech.

"We are grateful to Miss Mayuri for answering our questions and providing us with this information." —The Oasis HR Department

Despite being one of the three founding members of the strange organization known as the "Future Gadgets Lab", Mayuri has never participated in the development of any Future Gadgets and she doesn't even seem interested in research at all. For Mayuri, the main reason she takes part in Lab activities is because it makes her happy. However, this does not mean she does not contribute to the Lab. Her influence can be seen in each Round Table Conference, or the little things she does for Okabe and the others after long periods of overtime, and even in the names of each and every Future Gadget.

Even if she does not understand the full nature of the situation, she always ends up providing the necessary push in critical situations. Her nigh-supernatural instincts and detective-like insight are always able to help everyone through their difficulties. As long as Mayuri remains in the Future Gadgets Lab, she gives it a completely different atmosphere. Naturally, as LabMem No. 002, she steps forward when the time is right to contribute what she can to the little Lab.

Due to her innocent and offbeat nature, Mayuri often says and does things that easily invite misunderstandings, such as randomly blurting out "Mayushii is Okarin's hostage~", looking up into the sky, randomly standing still and extending her arm, and so on. These incidents are not only linked to Mayuri's personality but also her past. In her youth, her favorite thing was spending time with her grandmother, and being carried on her grandmother's back while watching the starry sky is a precious memory for her. As a result, after her grandmother passed away, Mayuri sank into depression for a while until she finally managed to extricate herself from her sadness with Okabe's help. Perhaps her longing for her grandmother led her to develop her habit of "Stardust Handshake".

Unlike her typical easygoing nature, Mayuri is surprisingly athletic. Perhaps that is the source of a special technique of hers, "Silent Return", where her very presence seems to vanish. Mayuri has a habit of running off without saying a word and then lazily strolling back afterward.

"She disappeared during the tour of the Oasis and scared me to death. But I soon met her again in the shopping street... She really is a mysterious girl."
—Cascadia

Mayuri was briefly surprised and worried after her sudden arrival in Magrasea, but her shocking ability to adapt soon showed itself. While she clearly had no idea what had happened, her lack of understanding did not stop her from blending into the Oasis.

Even after coming to a completely different world, Mayuri carried on in her own relaxed way in the Oasis. Her days were spent either making cosplay outfits in the Lab or working in the Oasis branch of the Mayqueen+Nyan² maid cafe, as though she were still in her previous world. When she learned the Oasis did not have "Upas", she was somewhat depressed, but then she threw herself into making new Upa-related items with her usual gusto.

Although Mayuri has lived in the Oasis for some time now, she does not seem to have noticed the differences between agents and humans. She quickly blended in with her friends in the Oasis and enjoys her life there. She has been sighted in just about every corner of the Oasis, from sewing with Chanzhi, watching anime with Croque and Nascita, and even attending Nanaka's concerts.

Meanwhile, Mayuri brought many of her likes from her previous world to the Oasis, such as the "Juicy Chicken No. 1!" sold in MayQueen+Nyan², to the episodes of RaiNet Kakeru played on loop in the lounge, the "Upa Hug Pillows" which are wildly popular in the Oasis, the cosplay outfits Mayuri designed for the agents... That said, there are still no records to date of Mayuri wearing any of the cosplay outfits she designed. It seems she prefers to have her friends wear her carefully-designed outfits rather than wearing them herself.

"This costume is a little embarrassing... But when Miss Mayuri looks at me with those expectant eyes, I just can't say no..."
—Bonee
